Operations.Name: InitshutdownscriptCreate
Operations.Description:
Create an initshutdown script task.

`type` indicates if a command or script should be executed at `when`.

There are three choices for `when`:

1) PREINIT - This is early in the boot process before all the services have started
2) POSTINIT - This is late in the boot process when most of the services have started
3) SHUTDOWN - This is on shutdown

`timeout` is an integer value which indicates time in seconds which the system should wait for the execution
of script/command. It should be noted that a hard limit for a timeout is configured by the base OS, so when
a script/command is set to execute on SHUTDOWN, the hard limit configured by the base OS is changed adding
the timeout specified by script/command so it can be ensured that it executes as desired and is not interrupted
by the base OS's limit.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Init/shutdown script configuration data for creation.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the init/shutdown script to delete.

Fields.Description: Must be given if `type="COMMAND"`.

Fields.Description: Optional comment describing the purpose of this script.

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether the init/shutdown script is enabled to execute.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the init/shutdown script.

Fields.Name: Script
Fields.Description: Must be given if `type="SCRIPT"`.

Fields.Name: Timeout
Fields.Description:
An integer time in seconds that the system should wait for the execution of the script/command.

A hard limit for a timeout is configured by the base OS, so when a script/command is set to execute on SHUTDOWN,     the hard limit configured by the base OS is changed adding the timeout specified by script/command so it can be     ensured that it executes as desired and is not interrupted by the base OS's limit.

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description:
Type of init/shutdown script to execute.

* `COMMAND`: Execute a single command
* `SCRIPT`: Execute a script file

Fields.Name: When
Fields.Description:
* "PREINIT": Early in the boot process before all services have started.
* "POSTINIT": Late in the boot process when most services have started.
* "SHUTDOWN": On shutdown.
